title: Device and Process for Transferring Packaged Material to a Packaged Material Transport System or to a Storage Device

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: This reference describes a device for transferring items using a feed unit and a transfer station, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
This reference describes a feed unit and transfer station for items, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
This reference describes a device for transferring items using parallel feeding lines and a pusher, not a grip unit with a sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring items using parallel feeding lines and a pusher, not a grip unit with a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes a device for transferring items using parallel feeding lines and a pusher, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device arranged in a housing portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring items using parallel feeding lines and a pusher, not a grip unit with a sound-reducing device in a housing portion.
This reference describes a device for transferring items using feed units and temporary storage lines, not a grip unit with housing portions or air outlets.
This reference describes a device for transferring items, not a grip unit with an air collection device or air collection screw.
This reference describes a device for transferring items, not a grip unit with housing portions or air baffles for guiding exhaust air.
This reference describes a device for transferring items, not a grip unit with a battery coupling point or air baffles for directing exhaust air.
This reference does not discuss air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.

overall.why: This reference describes a device for transferring items using parallel feeding lines, temporary storage lines, and a pusher, which is unrelated to the subject invention's features concerning a vacuum handling apparatus with a grip portion, vacuum generator, and sound damping.
